visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video begins with a close-up shot of a hand holding a red Yokohama souvenir box featuring a maritime illustration. The scene quickly cuts to a brightly lit retail space with a sign reading '銘店' (Famous Stores) above a counter. Shelves are stocked with neatly arranged gift boxes and local delicacies under warm studio-style lighting. (2) A hand presents specific products to the camera, including 'Ramune Gummy' and 'Yokohama Tonkotsu' instant noodles. The camera then shows the exterior entrance of Ito Yokado and the LaLaport Yokohama building under clear, sunny daylight. A pedestrian in a white shirt is seen walking across a modern elevated walkway connected to the mall. (3) Inside the supermarket, vibrant displays of peaches and melons in white mesh packaging are shown. A hand picks up various 'cup food' items like sushi and udon. The environment is a clean, modern supermarket with bright fluorescent lighting and several shoppers visible in the background. (4) The footage moves to 'Toylo Park' on the second floor, featuring colorful neon signs and rows of white gashapon machines. A 'Taiko no Tatsujin' game machine is shown being played. A Nintendo display with a Mario figure and a large green dinosaur statue are featured as setting details. (5) The final segment showcases the clothing area with racks of 'Body Cooler' undershirts and 'Cool Socks' packages. A 'Found Good' store with Sanrio character merchandise is highlighted. The video ends at the tax-free service counter and shows a wide shot of the mall's atrium with escalators and a large Lotso character display.
